title: Create Tag Group
description:
Create a new Tag Group in the Intel Exchange platform.



> [!NOTE]
> The same endpoint can be used to clone an existing tag group. The cloned group retains all properties of the original, with copy appended to its name

body.name: name
body.description: Pass the name of the tag group.

body.name: tag_type
body.description: Pass the details of the tag type.

body.name: description
body.description: Pass the description of the tag group.

body.name: associated_tags
body.description: Pass a list of associated tags.
